title: Fruit of the Hymn
translation: This Rudrashtakam was spoken by a Brahmin to please Hara. Those who read it with devotion, Shambhu is pleased with them.
translation_hi: यह रुद्राष्टक एक ब्राह्मण ने शिव को प्रसन्न करने के लिए कहा था। जो मनुष्य इसे भक्ति से पढ़ते हैं, उन पर शंभु प्रसन्न होते हैं।

words.note: Instrumental: the agent of a passive.
Dative of purpose. tosha = satisfaction (Hindi संतोष).

grammar: A new meter: this closing verse is in Anushtubh, eight syllables per quarter, the meter of the Gita and the epics.
-ashtaka: 'a group of eight', as in Lingashtakam and Bilvashtakam.
Ye … tesham: 'those who … to them', relative and correlative.
